title: Jeri Makhdooma Da Qul
body:
Jeri makhdooma da qul dunya tei ehsaan hovay
<<DIVIDER>>
Saari qainat onday parday ton qurbaan hovay
<<DIVIDER>>
Vekh Kay veer nu oh behn kadi raj di nahi
Veer jis behn da ik raat da mehmaan hovay
<<DIVIDER>>
Sain farmaaya veeran aitth zarra kar cha Abbas
Gal chumaan tera poora amri da farmaan hovay
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra day laal kiti shaam di qaidan nu duaa
Alvida behn tera allah nigehbaan hovay
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash bekas te musaafir di cha paamaal karo
Aavay humsheer te na veer di pehchaan hovay
<<DIVIDER>>
Mei nawaasi haan mohammed di te khatoon di dhee
Aj mekoon deyo rida koyi musalmaan hovay
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra sani koon sada ronda o rahnday Sarwar
Jendi nazaraan dai agay shaam da zindaan hove
